ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag — the driver made no false arrival confirmation.
ruling.reasoning:
The rider was charged a $6.61 cancellation fee after the driver cancelled the RydeX booking at 22:46:50, 9 min 50 s after acceptance [F4][F7]. Under NS-0, a driver-sided cancellation is routed to NS-1 / NS-2 because the driver claims a rider no-show [F12], so the $6.61 can only stand if all of NS-1 (i)–(iii) hold.

NS-1 (i) fails: the record shows no arrival confirmation at all — the driver never tapped "I'm Here" and the platform recorded no automatic arrival (driver_pressed_here_at is null) [F6]. The driver's own statement confirms this ("I forgot to press the I'm Here button") [F12], and a driver's after-the-fact statement cannot supply the missing confirmation [F6]. NS-1 (ii) therefore fails as well: there is no moment of arrival confirmation at which the car's distance from the pickup could be measured [F6]. NS-1 (iii) fails for the same reason: the continuous-wait clock runs only from the arrival confirmation, and with no confirmation the trace measures 0 s of post-confirmation waiting against the >180 s threshold [F6], even though the car sat stationary 40 m from the pickup for 4 min 0 s [F3] and was within 200 m for 5 min 20 s in total [F2][F5]. The chat messages ("At the pickup point, silver Toyota Altis" at 22:43 [F9]; "Waited 4 min, cancelling" at 22:46 [F10]) are timestamped [F11] but only describe the driver's own position and intentions; they are not an arrival confirmation by the driver's button or by the platform [F6].

Because NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) each fail, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full, and the rider bears no cancellation fee [F7][F4]. The NS-2 account flag is not triggered, because the driver never pressed "I'm Here" while outside the pickup radius — there was no confirmation at all, so there is no fake confirmation to flag [F6][F1]. NS-3's driver-cancellation rate mechanism is a separate operational matter and produces no flag here.

No traffic excuse is needed or available for a no-show dispute: no incidents were recorded and only an ordinary speed band appears on Woodlands Avenue 5 [F14][F13]. The fare record contains no unpublished item — the fee is exactly the published $6.61 cancellation fee, so FARE-1 does not add anything [F7]. No route-deviation segments exist in this case, so segment_findings is empty. Refund follows NS-7 (voucher form; Ryde retains final discretion).

rejected_claims.reason: No rider claim was advanced; the rider advocate made no assertion to reject. The rider's complaint that they were 'on my way down' is consistent with the record — the fee cannot stand regardless, because NS-1 (i) is unmet: no arrival confirmation exists (F6), and the driver admits not pressing 'I'm Here' (F12).

The driver's no-show defence fails under NS-1 (i): no arrival confirmation on record (F6), and the driver's statement that he 'was there' but forgot to press the button (F12) cannot substitute for the confirmation NS-1 requires. NS-2 therefore refunds the $6.61 in full (F7).

Any claim that ~4 minutes of physical waiting (F3) satisfies NS-1 (iii) is rejected: the continuous-wait requirement runs only after an arrival confirmation, and with no confirmation the post-confirmation wait is 0 s against the >180 s threshold (F6).
